Name: Kids Furniture
Author: spotteddotted
Description:
[b]Content:[/b]
[list]
[*]31 new furniture items
[*]Mostly taken from Jas and Vincent's rooms, as well as additions by myself
[*]Includes items fitted for outdoor use
[/list]
[b]Warning:[/b]
[list]
[*]This is a mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]CF[/url]﻿ by platonymous! You will have to have that downloaded in order for this to work!
[*]This adds furniture to your game rather than changing existing furniture, so you will have to buy it
[/list]
[b]Thank you:[/b]
[list]
[*]To platonymous for this wonderful mod, to the ever-so-helpful folks over on the Stardew Valley Discord, and to anyone who left encouragement, suggestions, or endorsements on my other mods!
[/list]
[b]Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]You may notice that things seem to be either green or purple. I didn't want to have a gender binary thing going on, but those appear to be Jas and Vincent's colours so that's what I worked with
[*]In order to place furniture outside as seen in the screenshot, you will need[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254?tab=files] Custom Furniture Anywhere[/url]﻿ and its requirements
[*]Thank you again everyone who downloaded my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3128]previous[/url]﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3121]mods[/url]﻿ and left nice comments! That means the world to me!
[*]Don't be afraid to suggest other furniture that you want in the game. This itself is a result of that (thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4853639]alissad[/url]﻿)!
[/list]
